import json,collections
p='answers.jsonl'
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open(p)]
for i,slot in [(42,'1'),(53,'1'),(55,'1'),(68,'2'),(78,'2')]:
 a[i-1]['note']=f'Slot {slot}: printed glyph is ѣ.'
a[25]['confidence']['1']='low'
a[25]['note']='Short top projection read as a left flag.'
with open(p,'w') as f:
 for x in a: f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
r=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
assert len(a)==len(r)
for x,y in zip(r,a):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,x['slots']+1)}
 assert set(y['slots'])==expected
 assert set(y['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in y['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in y['confidence'].values())
 assert y['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
print('Validated count, order and slot coverage:',len(a),'items')
c=collections.Counter(v for y in a for v in y['slots'].values())
print('Slot calls:',dict(c),'total',sum(c.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(y['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for y in a))
